title: OnePlus kernel build profile
description: One file per buildable device under configs/<aNN>/. Every key is mapped to an OP_<KEY> environment variable by the build action, so adding a key here means adding a consumer in .github/actions/build-kernel/action.yml.

model.description: Device identifier. Must match the op_model workflow choice, or be that choice plus a '-' suffix (op_model=OP15 selects OP15 and OP15-COS17).

os_version.description: OxygenOS/ColorOS major version. Drives the matrix split and the release grouping.

zyc_compiler.description: Optional Zyc compiler path; empty means unused.

c_compiler.description: Clang bin directory, relative to the kernel platform root.

rust_compiler.description: Rust toolchain bin directory, relative to the kernel platform root.

bindgen.description: Optional bindgen path; empty means unused.

hmbird.description: HMBIRD SCX scheduler. Silently skipped when no fengchi_<model>_<os>.patch exists upstream.

bbg.description: Baseband Guard. Keep false on devices that need EFISP/bootloader-spoof chains.

ip_set.description: IP set support plus the IPv6 NAT /proc/config.gz hiding patch.

blacklist_modules.description: Comma-separated module names to drop from the build.

uname.description: Appended to the kernel release string as LOCALVERSION, so uname -r becomes '<kernel version>-<android_version>-<uname>'. Two distinct uses, chosen deliberately: a short brand string (e.g. SakFi-OP) marks the build visibly; a full stock-style suffix (e.g. 6-g242e1a07f878-ab15865446-4k) makes uname -r indistinguishable from a stock OnePlus kernel. A brand string defeats the spoof, a spoof string hides the brand. LOCALVERSION_AUTO is disabled, so no git hash is appended after it.

bore.description: BORE scheduler. Only patches exist for 6.12; other kernel versions skip the step.

adios.description: ADIOS I/O scheduler. Only patches exist for 6.12.

autofdo.description: Clang AutoFDO using Google's kernel.afdo profile for android16-6.12. gki_defconfig already sets CONFIG_AUTOFDO_CLANG=y, but without a profile that only adds unused debug info; this supplies CLANG_AUTOFDO_PROFILE. The profile is pinned by commit and verified by sha256, and a failed download or hash mismatch aborts the build rather than silently producing a kernel without it. 6.12 only.

damon.description: DAMON data access monitor, as shipped by Android 17's GKI. Builds DAMON_RECLAIM and DAMON_LRU_SORT but starts nothing: kdamond only runs when a userspace policy enables it, so the cost when unused is code size only.

kasan.description: Build with KASAN. Off by default: gki_defconfig ships CONFIG_KASAN=y plus CONFIG_KASAN_HW_TAGS=y, and because arm64 selects HAVE_ARCH_KASAN_HW_TAGS whenever ARM64_MTE is on (it is default y), a plain 'make gki_defconfig' keeps both. The runtime default is sync mode, the most expensive one. KASAN is a debug detector, not a hardening feature, and Google keeps it out of production GKI. KFENCE stays on either way: it depends only on HAVE_ARCH_KFENCE, and its own Kconfig recommends it for production kernels that cannot afford KASAN. Set true to build a KASAN kernel for debugging.

mlgo.description: ML-guided register allocation. Requires a +mlgo clang (r547379 is).

susfs_hash.description: Pin SUSFS to one commit for this device only. Unpinned devices on the same KMI keep using the workflow input or the default branch.

ksu_hash.description: Override the SukiSU-Ultra ref for this device. Resolved and validated at matrix time.

blocked.description: Why this profile cannot be built today. A profile carrying this field is excluded from the build matrix, so selecting its model family builds the siblings that do work instead of failing the whole run. Selecting it on its own fails immediately with this text instead of failing 20 minutes later at a patch step. Remove the field when the blocker is gone. scripts/validate-configs.py checks that the README's known-unbuildable table and this field agree.

tested.description: What was verified on real hardware, and on which build. Absent means the profile has never been flashed: a green build proves it compiles, not that it boots. Example: 'v2.2.0-r1 on OxygenOS 16.0.0.201: boot, suspend/resume, camera, modem, Wi-Fi'. Surfaced in the release notes so an untested zip is visibly untested.
